The complete local test executes this exact public arity during QuickJS macro expansion: both global/explicit hierarchy query and mutation arities, native bases/supers, eight-field MultiFn construction, IMultiFn satisfaction, method operations and accessors. Replayed defmulti/defmethod setup supplies the macro-invoked dispatch function. Literal assertions verify results; source registration alone is not evidence.

The complete canonical application/macro contract executes this public name at its exact declared constructor/fixed/variadic arity before returning expansion data. It retains saved constructor/range/comparator callbacks, direct ISorted calls, comparator identity and equality classes, metadata, immutable updates, hash/equality, numeric key behavior and visible error paths. Public TreeMap/TreeSet/TreeMapSeq constructor arities retain meaningful collection operations with canonical empty or singleton public entry setup; no private red-black node storage claim is made.
